idea-plugin.name: Agents Deck: Sentry
idea-plugin.description:
Puts your Sentry issues behind the # completion in Agents Deck — with the crash's stack trace already in the prompt.

  • # in chat — search your organization's issues, or type a short id like BACKEND-1A2B outright; the title, the culprit and the latest event's top frames travel with the prompt, so the agent starts from the stack trace rather than from a link.
  • Links in agent output — BACKEND-1A2B opens the issue, for the projects your organization actually has.
  • Settings › Connections › Integrations › Sentry — which token is in force, which organization it belongs to, and what to set when there is none.

Authentication is a Sentry auth token read from SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN in your environment, or from the env block of a configured stdio MCP server — the same name sentry-cli reads, along with the optional SENTRY_ORG and SENTRY_URL. No browser sign-in, and nothing is stored by this plugin. With no token set, it contributes nothing at all — the chat is exactly the chat Agents Deck ships.
